name: Shipment booking and tracking
description: Customers book, amend and track shipments; staff update status and documents
workaround: Take bookings by email into a shared spreadsheet; phone carriers directly
key_dependencies: Entra ID; internet; freight management system supplier

name: Customs declarations
description: Prepare and submit import and export declarations
peak_periods: Port and airport peaks; Monday mornings
workaround: Use the authority's published contingency procedure and supplier phone line
key_dependencies: Freight management system; internet; supplier service; authority portals
regulatory_contractual_driver: Customs legislation and authorisation conditions; customer SLAs
notes: Confirm contingency procedure with compliance lead before an incident

name: Warehouse receipt, pick and dispatch
description: Goods in, stock location, picking, loading and dispatch with handheld scanners
peak_periods: Peak season; end of day dispatch
workaround: Paper pick lists and manifests; manual stock count afterwards
key_dependencies: On-premises Active Directory; site network; Wi-Fi; freight management system
notes: Paper stock for 8 hours is the agreed limit

name: Customer service and phone lines
description: Inbound and outbound calls, shared mailbox
workaround: Divert main number to mobiles; use shared mailbox on mobile
notes: Divert plan tested twice a year

name: Email and collaboration
workaround: Personal phones for urgent calls; secondary messaging group
key_dependencies: Entra ID; DNS; internet; third-party backup
notes: RPO depends on third-party backup frequency

name: Invoicing and credit control
description: Raise customer invoices and chase debt
workaround: Delay invoicing; keep manual list of completed jobs
key_dependencies: Freight management system; finance system; Entra ID
notes: Delay costs cash flow, not safety

name: Supplier payments and payroll
workaround: Bank portal direct access; previous period payroll as template
key_dependencies: Finance system; bank; HR system; Entra ID
notes: Payroll days treated as Tier 1 for that day

name: Card payments from customers
description: Take card payments through a hosted gateway
workaround: Take payment by bank transfer; invoice later
key_dependencies: Payment gateway supplier; internet; finance system
regulatory_contractual_driver: Payment card scheme rules; PCI DSS
notes: Cardholder data stays with the gateway supplier

name: File shares and scanned documents
description: Shared documents, scanned proof of delivery and signed paperwork
workaround: Use SharePoint copies; request documents again from carriers
notes: Move static content to SharePoint over time

name: Identity and access
description: Sign-in, MFA and Conditional Access for staff and systems
workaround: Break-glass cloud admin accounts; documented manual access for critical systems

name: Network and internet connectivity
description: Site networks, firewalls, VPN, internet circuits
notes: Configuration backups taken after every change

name: Sales CRM and quoting
workaround: Spreadsheet quotes; export of key accounts
